setlist.info:
Bruce joins Tom Morello's private jam session, which lasted about three hours. Other performers include Dave Matthews, 
Jesse Malin, Adam Weiner, Corey Glover,
Vernon Reid, Daryl "DMC" McDaniels, Taylor Momsen, Anne Preven, D.B. Weiss, and Ike Reilly

setlist.info: Bruce Springsteen backed by Tom Morello's band for "Clampdown" and all songs afterward
Solo acoustic; Virtual appearance at Dana-Farber Cancer Institute's "State of the Pan-Mass Challenge" event at the College of the Holy Cross in Worcester, MA.
Solo acoustic. Bruce received the ACLU's inaugural Ralph Ellison Award for Defenders of Civil Rights and Civil Liberties in the Arts, Business, Science, and Sports.

Recipient of the Harry Belafonte Voices for Social Justice Award at the Tribeca Festival. Interviewed by Bono, introduced by Robert DeNiro. Also joined Patti Smith on reprise bgvs with Bono during her performance of "People Have the Power".
